No. Final pricing requires approved scope, drawings, specifications, quantities, site conditions, schedule, and formal commercial review.

A growing Hajj and Umrah agency needed a professional landing page that could present its pilgrimage packages clearly, answer common traveler questions, and generate structured booking inquiries.

How far the accommodation was from important locations
Whether flights and local transport were included

A growing fragrance store needed an e-commerce website that could help mobile customers discover perfumes, understand fragrance details, and place orders conveniently through WhatsApp.

Webnion planned a mobile-first fragrance shopping experience that connected informative product pages with a simple WhatsApp ordering journey.
The goal was to reduce customer uncertainty, make fragrance selection easier, and help interested visitors start an order conversation without navigating through a complicated process.

The fragrance store offered multiple perfumes, oils, body sprays, gift sets, and fragrance variations.
Customers frequently asked questions such as:

items: What does the perfume smell like?

What are the top, middle, and base notes?

Is it suitable for daily use or special occasions?
Can the order be placed through WhatsApp?

Bottle sizes and prices caused confusion

items: Make perfume information easy to understand

en.text: 1.Project Overview
A growing beauty store needed an e-commerce website that could present individual products, value-focused bundles, promotional discounts, and customer reviews through one clear shopping experience.

The business offered products across skincare, makeup, haircare, personal care, and beauty accessories. However, presenting a large collection without a proper structure could make it difficult for customers to understand which products suited their needs or which offer provided the best value.
Webnion planned a responsive beauty e-commerce experience focused on product discovery, bundle presentation, transparent discounts, social proof, and simple purchasing actions.
The goal was to help customers understand products and promotional offers more easily while giving the business a flexible platform for future campaigns and product growth.

4. Our Strategy
We planned the shopping experience around three important customer questions:
What does this product do?
Why should I trust it?
Why is this offer valuable?
The customer journey was structured as:
Discover the product → Understand its benefits → Compare individual and bundle options → Review the discount → Check customer feedback → Add to cart
This approach connected product education, promotional value, and customer trust within one journey.
Instead of displaying discounts as isolated numbers, the website explained what customers would receive and why the offer could be useful.

24. Frequently Asked Questions
What is a beauty product bundle?
A beauty bundle combines multiple related products into one offer, often at a better total price than purchasing each item separately.
Can the website show the original and discounted price?
Yes. The website can display the regular value, bundle price, discount percentage, and total savings clearly.
Can customers see which products are included?
Yes. Each bundle can include a complete list of products, quantities, images, sizes, and relevant variations.
Can customers review a specific bundle?
Yes. Reviews can be connected to individual products or specific bundle offers.
Can the website support seasonal beauty campaigns?
Yes. The business can create bundles and landing sections for Eid, weddings, holidays, product launches, or other campaigns.
Can customers select shades or variations inside a bundle?
This can be supported when the bundle structure allows customers to select compatible product variations.
Is the website suitable for mobile shoppers?
Yes. Bundle details, discount information, reviews, cart actions, and checkout can be optimized for smartphones.
Can the business add more bundle types later?
Yes. The system can support future routine bundles, gift sets, trial kits, and campaign-specific offers.
